adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler, decryption is only reached after `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED) return 403`. `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` (added in `packages/lib/constants.ts`) is truthy only when `process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is set (and webhook secret set). Therefore, when the env var is unset, the handler exits before calling `symmetricDecrypt`, so it does not “silently fall back to an empty-string key” in that scenario. (Key length validation is not shown, but that’s different from the specific claim.)
